neighbours.label: (guess) the verb ' guarantee' and similar assurance words in a purpose clause: 'work there to guarantee the quality'
fire: Inspectors work on site to guarantee the quality of the parts.
We test each unit to guarantee a long service life.
Technicians stay nearby to guarantee a safe landing.
The firm checks each box to guarantee fresh delivery.
Staff will stay late to guarantee the launch.
Extra checks are made to guarantee accuracy.
Engineers work beside the machines to guarantee safety.
The chef tastes everything to guarantee good food.
quiet: Inspectors eat on site near the sheds with the parts.
We paint each unit in a long clean hall.
Technicians live nearby in a small house.
The firm stores each box in the old barn.
Staff will stay late to clean the floor.
Extra chairs are made in the workshop.
Engineers sit beside the machines at lunch.
The chef washes everything in the sink.
